title: China’s ‘Sky Eye’ FAST radio telescope opens to the world to aid global research
excerpt: The 500-meter aperture spherical radio telescope (FAST), also known as China’s Tianyan or “Sky Eye,” officially opened to the world on Wednesday and will accept observation applications from scientists around the world.…
body:
The 500-meter aperture spherical radio telescope (FAST), also known as China’s Tianyan or “Sky Eye,” officially opened to the world on Wednesday and will accept observation applications from scientists around the world.
